system.description:
You can make a Strafing Attack without a Vehicle.

Prerequisite: Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: When you make an Autofire attack, instead of attacking a 2-square-by-2-square area, you may attack a line 1 square wide and 4 squares long.

Special: If you are using a Jet Pack, you can use the Strafe feat to make an Autofire attack against all squares you fly over.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
